scope: Independent production website gate and sanitized upload QA

checks.name: Missing credentials and unsafe origin fail startup without exposing environment values
Anonymous private HTML/assets/API are gated and login never reflects password query
Login rejects absent/wrong/duplicate proof and cross-origin requests without issuing cookies
Twenty bad guesses throttle, spoofed forwarded IP cannot reset it, correct password still works
Oversized/malformed login body is bounded even if underlying cancellation never resolves
Unfinished login stream returns bounded timeout without waiting for EOF
Signed cookies use host-only secure flags, reject forgery/expiry/future issuance and duplicates
Authenticated assets load with security headers; traversal, hidden auth, symlinks and source paths cannot disclose files
Mutation CSRF and logout enforce exact origin; no GET logout or cross-site session grant
Production API ignores injected identity/admin/allowlist and local-development bypass remains denied
Actual runtime app uses the session auth while anonymous API remains closed
Browser cookie cannot authorize internal Miro token route; separate broker proof is required
Sanitized upload contains only reachable runtime and typed build assets, excluding private root files
Sanitized upload fails closed on hidden auth, symlinked assets, source escape, dynamic loader and unreviewed dependency

limitations: Synthetic fixtures and in-memory HTTP requests; no Railway, real account, source or model calls.
Shared signed cookies expire; logout clears the browser cookie and does not revoke an already copied token.
Static assets are trusted build output; this pass tests exclusion boundaries rather than scanning arbitrary embedded secrets.
